reviewer: Root computational image reviewer; nonblind and source-informed, not human or expert acceptance

observations.stationary: The same foreground layout persists in all four candidates; stationary geometry alone does not discriminate the cloud stage.

observations.contrary_and_limit: E420 and E421 are not visually distinguishable as unique exposures in this review. Earlier broad-shape similarities and the unviewed near-best alternatives are not excluded. Camera/framing changes affect the apparent position of the same structures.
observations.disposition: Changing-detail agreement supports a sequence lead beyond stationary scene similarity, not unique exposure, rate or clock.

observations.stationary: The same foreground structures are present, with substantial vertical framing variation across the four close-in-time candidate images.
observations.changing_detail: The advancing lower central roll around the foreground roofs is now conspicuous in the shortlisted later candidates, consistent with the more developed lower roll in C4. The upper cloud includes a similar bright knob and dark rounded mass.
observations.contrary_and_limit: E486/489/491/495 all show related cloud structures. The lower roll is partly outside the scored upper dynamic rectangle; its resemblance cannot be counted as an independently calibrated match. Detail, reframing and small raster size prevent a unique frame assignment. This narrows but does not erase the parent coarse-screen lower-roll discrepancy.
observations.disposition: Dense candidates better represent the later visible cloud stage than the old coarse E450 leader, but exact correspondence remains unresolved.

common_limits: The earlier copy has a dark lower strip and different framing/processing from C. Broad ordered cloud changes and shared scenery support common image material, but this selected follow-up has no calibrated false-match rate and no independent camera-origin authentication. Near-best bands are descriptive, correlated and partly unviewed. No soundtrack, original time, material classification, structural mechanism or intent is identified.
sound_boundary: The user-reported bang at C local13 is in a different shot; none of this first-shot comparison authenticates that sound or establishes acoustic absence.
